messages.text: Where can I get copy of the stock firmware for a DC06
Handed to the team · No official DC06 stock firmware download location in our docs (harlolabs.com onl

Hi, I am Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist.

On the DC06 firmware:

1. The Harlo OS downloads page (https://harlolabs.com/) only serves the Harlo / Bitaxe style boards, so the DC06 image is not there. I do not want to point you at a random mirror, so I have passed this to JD, our hardware lead, for the official stock image. He or the team will confirm here, and by email if you step away, usually within one business day.
2. Faster route if you want it now: our Discord https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , ping @nullhashrate (JD). He posts the official images there and the channel is very active.

One thing that helps while we wait: what are you trying to do with it? Recovering a unit that will not boot, rolling back after an update, or just keeping a backup copy? And if the unit does boot, tell me the firmware version shown in the web UI. That changes which image you need.

Good to know. Rollbacks are sometimes avoidable, so one question before we chase the image:

1. What went wrong after the update? For example no hashrate, pool not connecting, fans at full speed, UI not loading, or reboot loop.
2. And what version is it on now, plus the version it was on before, if you have it? Both show in the web UI under the system or firmware section.

With those two I can usually tell whether it is a settings reset side effect (very common after an update, and fixable in a minute) or a real regression that needs the older image.
Don’t have the unit with me I will check back later when I am near it

No problem. When you are back at the unit, grab these three things and send them here:

1. The current firmware version from the web UI.
2. The version it was on before the update, if you know it.
3. What the unit is actually doing wrong now, a short video or a screenshot of the UI is ideal.

JD is already looking for the official DC06 image, so the team will come back to you here or by email either way. If you want it sooner, ping @nullhashrate on our Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
Anytime. Message here when you are back at the DC06 with those details and we will pick it up from there.
